svg.title: Soperator Blue-Green Upgrade Workflow
svg.desc: Architectural evolution of the Slurm controller, login, accounting, system, worker, and Jail components during a blue-green Soperator upgrade.
svg.text: CAPACITY PREFLIGHT: bridge + retained source + every target replacement group must fit quota before mutation
Full-size source/target overlap is about 2× per role; worker targets may bootstrap incrementally

g.text: Scheduling resumes last • busy workers and protected SSH keep their source role until released
